title: Zoning text change for 1455 Coney Island Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 1455 Coney Island Avenue in Midwood, Brooklyn. It works together with a related zoning map change to facilitate a nine-story, about 157,000-square-foot long-term care facility with roughly 300 beds, office space, a café and a house of worship. The City Planning Commission issued its decision on September 9, 2026, and the Council held a public hearing on September 23, 2026.
